## Overview

## Release and platforms

Rockstar's pre-load page lists November 19, 2026 as the game's launch date.{{cite:gta6-pre-load-page}}{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} The company publishes PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as the supported platforms.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}}

## Editions and pricing

Grand Theft Auto VI is offered in Standard and Ultimate Editions.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} The Standard Edition contains the base game and can be upgraded later by purchasing the Ultimate Edition Upgrade.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} Take-Two lists the Standard Edition price at $79.99.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} Take-Two lists the Ultimate Edition price at $99.99.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} The Ultimate Edition provides an integrated collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel and other bonuses tied into Jason and Lucia’s narrative.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Digital pre-orders and purchases made before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack and a one-month GTA+ membership.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}

## Setting and protagonists

The story takes place in Vice City within the wider state of Leonida.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Lucia Caminos learned to fight from her father.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Fighting on behalf of her family resulted in a spell in the Leonida Penitentiary, from which she later gained release.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Jason Duval was raised around grifters and criminals and later served in the Army following troubled teenage years.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} After his military stint, Jason worked for drug runners in the Keys prior to meeting Lucia.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

summary: A PC version has not been announced, so there are no official PC specifications. The game is listed for PlayStation 5 and for Xbox's current Series consoles; official pre-load storage guidance is on the File size and storage page.
bodyMarkdown:
## PlayStation 5

Grand Theft Auto VI is offered for PlayStation 5 and listed as PS5 Pro Enhanced.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} The PS5 edition makes use of DualSense features, including haptic feedback, adaptive trigger resistance, and the controller's built-in speaker.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} The version on PS5 takes advantage of the console’s ultra-high speed SSD to provide near-instant load times.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Digital pre-orders on the PlayStation Store include a one-month GTA+ subscription that can be claimed before March 31, according to the store listing.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} PlayStation’s preload instructions indicate pre-loading began on November 10.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} The store notes that downloaded content may be used on the primary PS5 associated with an account and on other PS5 consoles when signing in with the same account.{{cite:playstation-gta6}}

## Xbox consoles and cloud streaming

Microsoft states that when Grand Theft Auto VI is streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming, the streamed sessions use the same graphics settings as the Xbox Series S.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Xbox Series X supports native play and can be pre-installed according to Xbox Wire.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Xbox Series S is identified as the most affordable option to play GTA VI natively on Xbox hardware.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Xbox Wire also cautions that streaming availability, purchase methods, the range of supported devices, account eligibility, and feature sets differ depending on market and device.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}}

## Storage

Official pre-load guidance talks about free space rather than a final per-platform installed size. PlayStation asks PlayStation 5 players to free at least 212 GB, and Rockstar says the pre-load can need as much as 212 GB depending on the device.{{cite:playstation-gta6}}{{cite:gta6-nw-preload-begins}} See [[file-size|File size and storage]].

summary: Digital pre-load on PlayStation 5 starts at local midnight on November 10, 2026. On Xbox, the window opens at 12 a.m. GMT that same date. Official guidance is to have as much as 212 GB free. An earlier Take-Two line used November 12; official sources disagree.

## Overview

Rockstar posted a newswire titled "Pre-Load Grand Theft Auto VI Now" on November 10, 2026 announcing that pre-loading was active for customers who had pre-ordered the game.{{cite:gta6-official-site}}{{cite:gta6-pre-load-page}}

## Platform start times

Rockstar's support page states that PlayStation 5 users can begin pre-loading at midnight local time on November 10.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}}  Microsoft’s Xbox team noted the title was the most pre-ordered on the Microsoft Store and advised customers to begin pre-loading early because of heavy demand.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}}

## Eligibility and physical codes

Rockstar’s support information explains that the physical edition ships with a digital download code rather than a disc and that those physical editions were expected to be available from November 12 to assist with pre-loading.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} The support page also states that codes included with physical copies can be redeemed as soon as they are received to enable pre-loading on November 10.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}}

## Digital pre-load date

Official communications provide more than one date for when digital pre-loading would start: a Take-Two press release said digital pre-orders could begin pre-loading on November 12, 2026, while Rockstar’s support documentation gives November 10 for PlayStation and a 12 a.m. GMT time for Xbox.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}}

## Storage guidance

PlayStation's PlayStation 5 guidance asks players to free at least 212 GB of storage ahead of pre-loading.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Rockstar says the pre-load can need as much as 212 GB, with the amount varying by device.{{cite:gta6-nw-preload-begins}} Fuller detail is on [[file-size|File size and storage]].

The boxed retail edition contains a digital download code for the game rather than an optical disc.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} Rockstar does not offer a boxed Ultimate Edition; after redeeming the Standard code, buyers may purchase the Ultimate Edition Upgrade on Sony's or Microsoft's digital storefronts.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}}

## Packaging and included content

Physical reservations ship with a single code that redeems both the game and the Vintage Vice City Pack.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} That pack comprises a '55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage, additional outfits and hairstyles, and an exclusive weapon pattern.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} Take-Two's announcement confirms that reservations and purchases made before November 20, 2026 qualify for the pack.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}

## Availability and pre-loading

Retail boxed copies are scheduled to begin shipping and be available for in-store pickup starting November 12, 2026.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} Rockstar says the enclosed codes can be redeemed as soon as they arrive, in time for the pre-load window that support documentation dates to November 10, 2026.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} Take-Two likewise described the boxed release as arriving in mid-November so buyers could pre-load.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}

## Region and redemption notes

Region restrictions for redeeming codes follow the region assigned to the buyer's platform account.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} Rockstar advises buying from a retailer in the same country as that account to reduce the risk of activation problems.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}}

title: Story
summary: What official sources have said about Grand Theft Auto VI's premise, its two central characters, and its setting in Leonida.
bodyMarkdown:
## Official premise

Rockstar's site presents a story centered on Jason and Lucia, who have always known the odds were against them.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} The site says an attempted easy job goes wrong, pulling them into a criminal conspiracy that stretches across the state of Leonida and leaving them dependent on each other if they want to get out alive.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Take-Two describes the game as a single-player experience.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}

## Protagonists

The narrative follows two lead characters, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, whose biographies appear in Rockstar's Only in Leonida pages.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Rockstar describes Lucia as recently released from prison and determined to improve her circumstances after fighting for her family and serving time in the Leonida Penitentiary.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Jason is presented as someone who wants an easy life but keeps running into harder circumstances; his official biography notes a childhood around grifters and crooks, a stint in the Army, and later work for drug runners in the Keys.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## Setting

Rockstar locates the story in Vice City, USA, and characterizes it as the darker side of a sun-drenched part of the United States.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} The Only in Leonida pages identify the state as home to the neon-lit streets of Vice City and the areas around them.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}}

## Overview

Rockstar's official biographies for Grand Theft Auto VI center on two protagonists, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, along with several associates introduced in the Only in Leonida material.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} The official site frames their story around a job that goes wrong and a criminal conspiracy that stretches across Leonida.{{cite:gta6-official-site}}

## Protagonists

Lucia Caminos's biography says she learned to fight young and later served time in the Leonida Penitentiary after fighting for her family.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Jason Duval is described as someone who grew up around grifters and crooks and later worked for local drug runners in the Keys.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} The material notes that meeting Lucia could prove either very good or very bad for him.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## Associates named in official biographies

Official write-ups also cover Cal Hampton, a friend of Jason who also works with Brian; Boobie Ike, called a Vice City legend; Dre'Quan Priest, who signed the Real Dimez; Real Dimez, the duo Bae-Luxe and Roxy; Raul Bautista, described as a seasoned bank robber; and Brian Heder, a veteran drug runner from the Keys.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} Those pages underpin the individual character articles in this section.

bodyMarkdown:
## Overview

Rockstar's official character materials present Jason Duval as someone who wants an easy life, even as circumstances keep getting harder.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} They describe him as having grown up around grifters and crooks.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## Army service and the Keys

According to Rockstar, Jason spent a period in the Army trying to leave a troubled adolescence behind.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} After that, he ended up in the Keys doing the work he already knew, employed by local drug runners.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} The official profile also suggests it may be time for him to try something new.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## Connection to Lucia Caminos

Rockstar's materials note that crossing paths with Lucia might turn out very well or very badly for him, and that he knows the outcome he would prefer even if nothing is settled yet.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Lucia's own profile presents a relationship with him as a possible escape.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}

title: Leonida
summary: Leonida is the fictional U.S. state Rockstar has named as the setting of Grand Theft Auto VI, including Vice City and other destinations listed on official pages.
bodyMarkdown:
## Overview

Rockstar markets Leonida as the U.S. state that contains the setting for Grand Theft Auto VI, including Vice City and other featured locations.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Promotional copy on the official site greets visitors with the phrase, "the state where anything goes."{{cite:gta6-official-site}} The site also frames the protagonists' story as unfolding inside a criminal conspiracy that stretches across that state.{{cite:gta6-official-site}}

## Destinations named by Rockstar

The Only in Leonida feature highlights a short tour of places in the state that the page presents as destinations worth seeing.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} The locations it names are Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} Lucia's official character biography also identifies the Leonida Penitentiary.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} The cited pages do not publish a comprehensive map of every place in the state, so this article lists only names the company has mentioned.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}}

## Role in the official premise

Rockstar locates Jason and Lucia's narrative in Leonida and describes their situation as the darker side of a sun-drenched part of the United States, tying the story to a conspiracy that spans the state.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Vice City is presented as a major urban center inside that state.{{cite:gta6-official-site}}

bodyMarkdown:
## Official description

Take-Two’s announcement and related press materials describe Grand Theft Auto VI as a single-player title and outline its launch details and pricing.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} PlayStation’s official product page likewise presents the game as a solo experience while listing platform-specific features and pre-order information.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Microsoft's Xbox communications and cloud-gaming announcement also identify the release as a single-player title while describing availability via cloud streaming and native console play.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}}

## Storefront listings and editions

The PlayStation Store listing for the Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition reiterates the game’s single-player framing and enumerates the Ultimate Edition’s included items and system features.{{cite:playstation-store-ultimate}} Take-Two’s pre-order release and the Xbox storefront describe the Ultimate Edition and list pre-order incentives such as the Vintage Vice City Pack.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}}

## Cross-play and multiplayer status

Official listings used on this page describe a single-player game and do not announce a cross-play feature or a Grand Theft Auto VI multiplayer mode.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}{{cite:playstation-gta6}} This wiki does not treat cross-play as confirmed.

Pre-order materials mention a one-month GTA+ offer that can be redeemed for the existing GTA Online service and other Rockstar titles, which is separate from a VI multiplayer mode.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}{{cite:playstation-store-ultimate}}
